subject: Re: Kickoff: AutoML-Zero as an internal algorithm-discovery tool
body:
Status + the key risk for the 6/1 decision.

Done: search baselines reproduced, and the 5-minute linear-regression demo runs in our infra. On the internal task family (binary classification over retrieval features), evolution found a variant with input-noise augmentation and weight averaging that edges our logistic baseline by 0.9 AUC points on held-out tasks. Genuinely interpretable, which was the bet.

The risk: reproducibility of discovery. Across 20 seeded runs, only 6 rediscover something at or above baseline; the rest plateau on degenerate programs. That's consistent with the paper's framing (the search space is brutal), but it means the "discovery service" pitch needs framing as a batch lottery - you fund 20 runs to get 5 candidates - not a push-button tool. Cost per useful candidate lands around $9k at current core prices.

Full readout in the 5/20 review.

Freya
